description: This file defines an API client class for backend communication in a Flutter project. It provides methods for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests, manages base URL resolution from environment variables, handles HTTP headers, and processes responses, throwing exceptions on errors.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A client for communicating with the backend API, supporting GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests, with automatic base URL resolution and response handling.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: An exception class representing errors during API calls.

methods.name: ApiClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HTTP client and resolves the base URL.

methods.name: _resolveBaseUrl
methods.description: Determines the base URL from environment variables or defaults to localhost.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a complete Uri object from a path and optional query parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with an optional request body.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request with an optional request body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the specified path.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Returns standard headers for JSON content.

methods.name: _ensureSuccess
methods.description: Checks if the response status code indicates success; throws ApiException otherwise.

methods.name: throwIfNoop
methods.description: A helper method to satisfy control flow; always throws.
